shared_elements: carved stone surface with low-relief motifs
justification: Both are stone carvings that use shallow relief and include round disc-like motifs and curving incised bands, and each has a pair of round forms flanking a central axis, which is the most specific (if generic) correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat horizontal panel with a densely detailed, crisply modelled profile bird-headed creature in pale stone, while B is a monumental free-standing dark monolith with a weathered anthropomorphic body and sparse, coarsely incised markings.
